properties.name: SEVEN open questions had already shipped their answers — promotion has an instruction and no detector, which is 1 of the 3 legs, and 2 of 7 left no trace at all
properties.statement:
SWEPT 2026-09-14 over all 277 Decisions reading `proposed`, after two of the top five in `what_next` turned out on reading to be questions whose answers had already shipped.

═══ WHAT IT FOUND ═══

FIVE ideas carry an `EVOLVES_INTO` edge to something already ACCEPTED or REALIZED — the edge the brainstorm discipline draws from an idea to what it became. Promoted, never closed:
  · the units question -> two accepted requirements
  · the status-past-its-own-prose question -> cap:a-status-advance-says-whether-its-prose-predates-it, REALIZED and observed firing twice on 2026-09-13
  · the agent's-notepad question -> req:a-lesson-is-served-at-the-step-it-concerns, accepted AND built
  · the pseudo-design question -> two accepted requirements
  · the /feedback-tally question -> req:feedback-on-reflow2-is-computed-from-a-record-the-server-kept, accepted AND built

TWO MORE were found only by READING, because nobody drew the edge: `dec:how-should-reflow2-log-its-own-usage` (answered the way it recommended — the ledger is at `<graph-path>.usage.jsonl`, beside the store, with a test named for it) and `dec:how-a-session-is-pointed-at-a-design` (answered 2026-09-13 by `/g/<graph_id>/`; cap:select-graph-by-id's description already said it "Contributes an answer to" this decision, IN PROSE, where no query reads it).

🛑 A CLAIM IN THE FIRST VERSION OF THIS RECORD WAS TOO STRONG AND IS WITHDRAWN. It said a promoted-but-open idea is "well connected and ranks HIGH", and that two of `what_next`'s top three were this. MEASURED AFTERWARDS: the seven sit at ranks 3, 6, 80, 88, 136, 142 and 228 of 277, against a median of 138 — SCATTERED, not systematically inflated. `EVOLVES_INTO` is not in the score at all, so promotion does not raise rank; the two I met early rank high because they happen to GOVERN things, and meeting them first is what made the pattern visible. It was 2 of the top FIVE, not the top three. The generalisation was drawn from the two instances that surfaced it.

⭐ THE REAL MECHANISM, AND IT IS THE PROJECT'S OWN THREE-LEG RULE: vocabulary reaches a design only with a TYPED TOOL, an INSTRUCTION, and a DETECTOR THAT NOTICES ABSENCE. Promotion has exactly ONE — the brainstorm skill's step 5 says to draw `EVOLVES_INTO`. There is no typed tool (no `promote`, and no `promoted_from` on add_requirement / add_capability), and no detector. One leg of three predicts precisely what was measured: the instruction is followed most of the time (5 of 7) and silently skipped the rest (2 of 7), and nothing ever notices either way.

📌 THE DETECTOR SHAPE ALREADY EXISTS FOR ANOTHER TYPE. `defect_overtaken_by_change` finds a defect that still reads open while later repairs touched its subject. The Decision analogue is the same rule and SIMPLER — one edge and one status, with no dates to parse and no artifact walk.

⚠️ HOW BIG IS IT, HONESTLY: 5 detectable of 277, which is 1.8%, plus an unknown number with no edge. The cost today is small. The argument for acting is that it RATCHETS — nothing ever closes these, every future promotion that skips the edge adds one, and the design reads as holding more open questions than it has.

NOTHING WAS CLOSED — `rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word` holds. Two missing `EVOLVES_INTO` edges were drawn, with evidence, so the query sees them next time.

WHAT IS NOT ESTABLISHED: how many of the remaining 270 are in the same state. Only edge-carrying promotions are detectable; the other two were found by reading two nodes, which is not a sample to generalise from.
